Title: [LSJ] Clarification on Retainer life outside of combat.

Messages.Author: Ethan Burrow
Messages.Body:
I was reading the new rulebook, and it states in section 6.4.7. that
retainers heal combat damage at the end of combat if not burned. What
about outside of combat via Cryptic Mission or Shadow Twin?

For instance, if I successfully Cryptic Mission a Raven Spy that was
recruited at superior...will it remain at 1 life for subsequent turns
until I draw another Cryptic Mission to finish the job? Since it lost
a life 'outside of combat' and thus cannot replenish it?

Messages.Author: pallando
Messages.Body:
this was aptly answered by tim two threads above when i asked the same
question:

Retainers

If damage is dealt to a retainer outside of combat, this permanently
reduces the retainer's life. [TOM 19951209]

regards

pallando
